27587.overview:
On a planet, a war is about to begin. The inhabitants of the planet have decided that the rules of war are to use the Anchor Machine to fight for position. You must use your anchor machine to unite 6 continents and 46 countries.

The game is a new type of formation game in which you fly your anchor to increase your position. The rules are quite simple: use the anchor machine to fly the anchor back to your position in three shots or less, and you'll be in your own territory. However, you must quickly expand your position by watching the wind direction, terrain and enemy movements. This is a highly puzzling game that requires the ability to use a variety of anchor machines and strategy.

27588.overview: Armored Unit is a WonderSwan exclusive sci-fi turn-based strategy game. Main gameplay modes are story mode, trial mode, and duel mode. In the story mode the player starts by selecting an armored unit out of several available which vary in type (i.e. knight, ranger, seeker), weapons, and basic stats such as health and energy, after which one progresses through a series of stages backed up by a short dialogue cut-scenes between the stages.

27610.overview:
A simple collection of two classic puzzle games, Gomoku Narabe & Reversi/Othello.

Gomoku Narabe is a ancient Japanese game the title of which means "five stones in a row". The goal of the game is to place five tokens of your color (white or black) in a row. Of course your opponent will be trying to block you. The game ends when a player achieves tis penta-worthy task. The board is 14 x 14.

Reversi is a game commonly known under the name that it is marketed by Pressman, Othello. In reversi ones goal is to flip the opponents tiles (white or black) by surrounding the opposing token(s) on either end with your own. The board is 8x8.

A challenge mode approaches! You can battle your way through ranks of board game master beginning with a horrid smiling goblin and moving up to a mysterious old guru.

Two players can play the game through the Communication Cable.
